collections.name: QuadGrifters by Harrow
collections.description:
QuadGrifters is not a PFP.

QuadGrifters is the blockchains first Proof of Life concept.
You don't buy access to the game. You buy a player other people can hunt.

4,444 fully on-chain NFTs on Robinhood Chain. Each Quad has its own address, its own Chroma, and something to lose.

Call another Quad with ETH. It gets 44 hours to clock in. If it answers, you pay. If it sleeps, you take its best Chroma. Strip it to Last Light, catch it sleeping again, and it goes #444444 for good. Same number. Same token. Killer on the tombstone.

No wallet connection. No approvals. No game server. The website only watches bodies stack up. Transactions are the controller. The chain is the game.

Half of every Call bond feeds a vault built to pay every 44 days to the Quads still lit. Fewer survivors. Fewer hands in the vault.

The art changes because the game changes.
Every Call is public. Every move leaves a receipt.

4,444 pressed. No second run.
Show up or get stripped.

collections.name: Clay StonKz
collections.description:
Clay StonKz is a collection of 6,969 clay characters inspired by markets, memes, crypto, stocks, bulls, bears, wins, losses, and the occasional rug pullz.

Every character and trait begins in the physical world. Brrrbon sculpt the clay by hand, photograph it, then bring those images into the digital world where they’re layered together to create the final collection.

Fingerprints, dents, uneven edges, mistakes, and texture are all part of the work. I’m not trying to make clay look digital. I’m trying to make the digital world look like it was made out of clay.

Real clay. Real photography.
Created physically. Collected digitally.
